{{Recipe summary
| Category = Peach recipes
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*4 ripe yellow [[Cookbook:Peach|peaches]], halved and pitted
*[[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|Granulated sugar]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] pure [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
*¼ cup unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*¼ cup peach nectar

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients except peaches and sugar. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over high heat in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] until reduced by half.
#Dip cut side of peaches into hot mixture. Sprinkle cut side liberally with sugar.
#Place peaches cut-side down on a high-heat [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] until marked and slightly charred. Serve warm with remaining sauce.
